summary: A test file plain-imports gomega and reads gomega.Expect/gomega.Succeed; the fix dot-imports both ginkgo and gomega so the spec reads Expect/Succeed unqualified, as this module's suites already do. The clean fixture also imports a gomega SUB-package, gomega/gstruct, qualified — and that must NOT fire, because CS-11 governs exactly the two full paths and a namespaced helper stays qualified.
